verdict.rationale: Coinbase x402 is an HTTP per-request payment protocol with a hosted facilitator. It has no concept of user-authored automations or workflows that could be versioned, reviewed or rolled back, so this axis is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships any automation-management capability that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
